items.title: Accelerate a World of LLMs on Hugging Face with NVIDIA NIM
items.summary: 来自原始信息源的最新动态，点击标题查看完整内容。
items.summaryZh: NVIDIA宣布其NIM推理微服务现已支持Hugging Face平台上的超过10万个大语言模型。通过提供统一的Docker容器及自动化的模型适配与量化检测，NIM旨在解决模型部署中常见的框架兼容性与性能优化瓶颈，帮助开发者更高效地将模型投入生产环境。

items.title: OpenAI and UK Government announce strategic partnership to deliver AI-driven growth
items.summary: OpenAI partners with the UK Government to boost AI adoption, drive economic growth, and enhance public services for a thriving AI ecosystem in the UK.
items.summaryZh: OpenAI宣布与英国政府建立战略合作伙伴关系，旨在通过AI技术提升公共服务效率并促进经济增长。该合作侧重于AI的社会化应用与生态建设。

items.title: AI as the greatest source of empowerment for all
items.summary: I’ve always considered myself a pragmatic technologist—someone who loves technology not for its own sake, but for the direct impact it can have on people’s lives. That’s what makes this job so exciting, since I believe AI will unlock more opportunities for more people than any other technology in history. If we get this right, AI can give everyone more power than ever.
